title: 035 null retrain: the S2 pipeline with no new input, ARO and GBR, f00-f07
label: DIAGNOSTIC -- no adoption, no promotion; one seed
identity: include_list, pre_normalized_columns, scaler, label, classifier, seed (1), training plans equal the controls'; own model key so it trains fresh
instrument: as S2: 0.5-share sizer thresholds picked on the validation tail (control_sizer.pick), gap on the early width-book trades (ARO 412, GBR 494)

interpretation.reproduces: |null gap - control-at-share gap| <= 0.02 on a model: retraining reproduces the control there; that model's S2 FAILs stand as input effects
interpretation.does_not_reproduce: |null gap - control-at-share gap| > 0.02: the control's gap is not reproducible by a retrain on this pipeline; that model's S2 comparison is re-read against the null
interpretation.re_read: an input whose S2 gap exceeds its model's null gap by > 0.02 on BOTH models is flagged for a seed-2 repeat (no pass, no adoption); otherwise the inputs add nothing over a retrain
interpretation.also: 0.02 is a declared allowance, not a measured noise level; the null itself is one seed

disclosed: S2 gaps on both models were read before this file (listed in references)
